name: Scroll of Firebolt
description: Written in a hurry by someone who then left the room. It is not a good sign when the margins are singed.
notes: A scroll of Firebolt (mw-ju8.4), spell.firebolt. Book kind scroll (mw-e07.1): reading it casts the spell once, free, for any class, and spends the scroll (owner decision 2026-10-24). That runtime is mw-ju8.17; `book.casts` is added with it, once spell content exists (mw-e08), because a spell reference to a missing spell fails the load. Base value 90 sits in the economy scroll band (40-150).
